STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_MONSIEUR_VERITE.des: The first time you [gold]Snapshot[/gold] each turn, heal 2 HP.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_MONSIEUR_VERITE.fla: An old companion from Fontaine, recording every moment of the world alongside Charlotte.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_MONSIEUR_VERITE_CHI: The first time you [gold]Snapshot[/gold] each turn, heal 4 HP.
A Chioriya Boutique custom job — exquisite, durable, and decidedly not cheap.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_SPECIAL_ANALYSIS_ZO: The first time you [gold]Snapshot[/gold] each turn, apply 2 [gold]Focus[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Born of an accidental investment, later beloved by Fontaine reporters everywhere.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_LENS_CAP.title: Lens Cap
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_LENS_CAP.descriptio: Whenever a [gold]Snapshot Souvenir[/gold] is Exhausted, gain 2 Block.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_LENS_CAP.flavor: The camera is a reporter's second pair of eyes — guard it well. It is far more delicate than you.
Whenever you [gold]Snapshot[/gold], Exhaust 1 random Status or Curse from your draw pile.
A thick notebook; many a brilliant story was born on its pages.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_LARGE_FISH_AND_CHIP: On pickup: lose 6 Max HP and restore all HP. At the end of each combat, gain 1 Max HP.
A Fontaine classic. Careful — don't burn your tongue.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_REPAIR_TOOLS.title: Repair Tools: Monsieur Verite Special
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_REPAIR_TOOLS.descri: Every 300 gold you spend in total, gain 1 random relic.
STS2_CHARLOTTE_RELIC_REPAIR_TOOLS.flavor: A precious toolkit that cost Charlotte a fair share of her salary — so Monsieur Verite is always in top form.
